title: Related prompts on every prompt page
hypothesis: Five Clef-ranked related prompt links on each prompt page raise human page views per prompt page, compared with the five prompts that no other page links to.
metric: human page views per /prompts/* page per window

title: Specific titles and descriptions on hub pages
hypothesis: Replacing the generic title and description on /, /blog and /projects with specific, keyword-bearing ones raises human page views on those pages, compared with post pages whose meta did not change.
metric: human page views per window on /, /blog, /projects

title: Descriptive titles on short-titled posts
hypothesis: Replacing bare one- to four-word titles on seven posts with titles that name the topic raises human page views on those posts, compared with similar-traffic posts whose title already names the topic.
metric: human page views per window on the seven retitled posts

title: List unlisted posts in the sitemap
hypothesis: Adding 14 crawlable but unlisted posts to sitemap.xml raises verified-crawler and human requests to those posts, compared with listed posts of similar age and traffic.
metric: human page views per window on the 14 newly listed posts

title: Resources hub: specific meta and sitemap entry
hypothesis: Giving /resources a specific title and description, and listing /resources and /research in sitemap.xml, raises human page views on those two hubs, compared with hub pages that did not change.
metric: human page views per window on /resources and /research

title: Read next links from high-traffic posts
hypothesis: Adding a Read next block with three related post links to /entropy-wall, /whos-driving and /liquid-primitives raises human page views on the nine linked posts, compared with posts of similar traffic that get no new inbound links.
metric: human page views per window on the nine linked-to posts

title: CollectionPage structured data on /prompts
hypothesis: Adding CollectionPage and ItemList JSON-LD that lists all 27 prompts to the /prompts index raises human page views on /prompts, compared with index pages that have no list markup.
metric: human page views per window on /prompts
